sure_s.not: bagli_cozum_toplam = bağlaşık entegrasyon + zaman alanı çıktıları + tarama + bafl + rijit karşılaştırma koşusu; tarama_tek_basina ürün yolundan AYRI ölçüm (ürün yolunda tarama RHS çağrısını zaman alanı çıktısıyla paylaşır)

dogrusal_sinir.kaynak: Dodge 2000 (SwRI, "The New Dynamic Behavior of Liquids in Moving Containers") p. 33: the wave departs markedly from linear behaviour once its amplitude exceeds about 10 % of the tank diameter; 0.2 R is the largest reasonable design amplitude.

bafl_onerisi.kaynak: Ring-baffle damping: Miles (1958) as given in Dodge 2000 Eq. (2.16); design wave amplitude eta/R = 0.05 (HRMA choice); ring spacing s/R = 3/(2*4.6) minimises the total ring area per unit tank length for a given target (HRMA choice); the +/- factor-2 band is an HRMA choice (scatter of Dodge 2000 Fig. 2.7). Ring depths smaller than the wave amplitude and fill ratios h/R <= 2 are outside the stated range of the correlation (declared). The re-scan repeats the frozen-coefficient burn scan with the baffle damping added to the wall damping.

kapsam_disi.gerekce: Control loop not modelled; for a guided vehicle this coupling is the main risk, and the hand-off table is meant for the vehicle team's GNC tool.

slosh_stability.basis: Linearised pitch-plane model (B-5)-(B-7) with frozen coefficients, evaluated at every sample of the coupled solution during the burn; the overall verdict is that of the worst window of the scan (consecutive samples whose coupled roots are unstable while the rigid body is stable), window edges refined by bisection between neighbouring samples. The four instants (lift-off, rail exit, peak dynamic pressure during the burn, burnout) are reported for reference. The yaw plane is identical by axial symmetry and is not repeated; roll is not modelled. Eigenvalues are cross-checked with the Hurwitz determinants (NASA SP-106 Eqs. 7.32-7.35) at the four instants and at the worst sample of each window; zeta_min is the smallest common slosh damping ratio that places all roots in the left half-plane (per window: at every sample of the window). The mechanism is the danger-zone / frequency-coalescence instability of a vehicle whose lateral force follows its attitude (Bauer, NASA SP-106 Ch. 7, Eqs. 7.42-7.45 and Fig. 7.13, with the aerodynamic normal force in the role of the attitude-control force).
